name: 52404 · Cedar Rapids, IA
findings: ZIP 52404 (Cedar Rapids) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52404 (Cedar Rapids) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52404 (Cedar Rapids) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
